description: Run a WebMCP tool the page declares (see webmcp_tools or the webmcp line of navigate): one call instead of the clicks and fields it replaces. Returns status (ok, error, timeout, not_found, inactive, needs_confirmation), the tool result and ms; navigated_to when the call led to another page. A sensitive tool (buy, pay, send, delete, a POST form) is not run without confirm:true: on needs_confirmation ask the user, then repeat with confirm.

confirm.description: true only after the user approved this sensitive action

frame_id.description: Target iframe id from get_frames; omitted = main frame

name.description: Tool name as listed by webmcp_tools

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

timeout.description: Abort the tool after this many ms

name: webmcp_call
